releaseNotesMarkdown:
### grafana/grafana

### [`v13.3.0`](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#1330-2026-10-27)

##### Security

- Security: Fix CVE-2026-100105
- Security: Fix CVE-2026-13719

##### Features and enhancements

- **Dashboards:** Make the auto grid to be default [#130749](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/pull/130749)
- **Packaging:** Remove bash dependency from alpine Docker image [#132643](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/pull/132643)
- **Provisioning:** Add generic git OAuth app connections [#134186](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/pull/134186)

##### Bug fixes

- **Alerting:** Fix import wizard losing staged config on reload

review.summary: 13.3.0 removes bash from the alpine image. local-stack/compose.yaml runs a /bin/bash init script against this image; the cluster uses the operator-managed image and is unaffected. Switch the script to sh or verify the image before merging.

breaking.title: Packaging: remove bash dependency from alpine Docker image
breaking.why: local-stack/compose.yaml grafana init command starts with /bin/bash

breaking.title: Dashboards: make the auto grid the default
breaking.why: every provisioned dashboard under the grafana dashboards directory sets explicit gridPos

features.title: Provisioning: generic git OAuth app connections
features.why: would let the as-code dashboards sync from GitHub without the obs-as-code OCI hop

affected_files.note: grafana service image pin and bash init script

verification.step: docker compose up grafana and confirm the init script completes
change the init command shebang to /bin/sh if bash is gone
